user.title: Server Room Climate Controller
user.description: Observe existing entities without sending equipment commands. Temperatures are required; equipment roles are optional. Configure publication-age limits for your upstream integrations. Values do not prove physical readback. Backup temperatures are sampled once per minute. Settings can be changed later. Primary and outdoor sensors may come from any compatible equipment. Assign zero, one or two backup sensors; each is optional.

data.backup_max_skew: Maximum time difference between backup readings
data.recovery_max_gap: Maximum gap in critical recovery measurements
data.recovery_hold: Critical recovery duration with falling temperature
data.ac_hard_min: AC minimum outdoor temperature (start forbidden at or below)
data.reported_freshness_confirmed: Use HA publication age for observation; I understand this does not prove physical device freshness

error.invalid_entity: An entity has an unsupported domain or identifier.
error.duplicate_entity: Use distinct entities for different roles.
error.invalid_timing: Enter finite positive age/gap limits and nonnegative tolerances; sampling tolerance must be below 60 seconds.
error.invalid_thresholds: Check the temperature thresholds and recovery duration.
error.entity_not_found: A selected entity is not present in HA.
error.invalid_temperature_unit: Temperature units must be Celsius, Fahrenheit or Kelvin.
error.self_reference: SRCC outputs cannot be used as SRCC inputs.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one controller is supported in this release.
